limitations: The sample ranks already allocated save chunks, so it measures observed generated terrain only and inherits where the player explored.
Biome is scored at the saved highest-block quart sample; season-dependent climate tint is not part of this climate metric.
Ground requires exact block IDs for solids and exact class for fluids; overlapping player edits are not distinguished from generation.
Leaf coverage includes foliage written by every mod and is not the exact placed-tree set.
Scores are diagnostics by system and denominator; they must not be pooled into one world-wide error rate.

reference_provenance.method: allocated region slots ranked by SHA-256(VERSION:chunkX:chunkZ), retaining first N FULL TFC chunks
notes: This is a deterministic spread sample of already allocated/generated save chunks, not a sample of unexplored coordinates.
Raw quart surface biome, TFC chunk climate corners, TFC surfaceHeight, highest saved block, substrate, and leaf presence are kept as distinct observations.
Feature chunks include local player exploration bias; results are not a universal world-wide generation guarantee.
